content_sections.heading: About Pondicherry University Project Associate-I
content_sections.text: Pondicherry University is conducting a walk-in interview to appoint one Project Associate-I on a temporary contract basis to work in a ANRF-Partnerships for Accelerated Innovation and Research (ANRF-PAIR) Network project entitled "An Eight Institution Partnership for Advancing Materials Research and Development: From Fundamental Design to Emerging Applications in Structural, Functional and Biomaterials Spaces" at Pondicherry University, Pondicherry. The positions are for 1 year from the date of appointment. As this project is a network project with Indian Institute of Science Bangalore as Hub and other Institutes (IEST Shibpur, Calicut University, Kuman University, Bangalore University and NIT Nagaland) as Spoke, during the project execution, the selected candidates may have to travel to these institutes for carrying out collaborative work.
